Home.heroTitle: Your SaaS, without the months of setup.
Home.heroSubtitle: BuilderLab gives you working sign-up, login, subscriptions, and a dashboard from day one — so you can spend your time on what makes your product different, not on the plumbing every product needs.
Home.featuresSectionTitle: Everything a SaaS needs, already wired together
Home.featuresSectionDescription: No developer to hire, no tools to stitch together — it's already built in and ready to use.

auth.title: Secure login, built in
auth.description: Sign-up, login, password reset, and two-factor email verification all work on day one — nobody has to build a login screen or think about password security.

billing.title: Get paid from day one
billing.description: Accept subscription payments and let customers manage their own plan and billing details — no payment code to write.

dashboard.title: A dashboard, ready to grow
dashboard.description: Your users land in a real, working dashboard the moment they sign up. Add your own screens on top whenever you're ready.

i18n.title: Ready for the world
i18n.description: Built to support more languages from the start, so reaching customers in another country is never a rewrite — just a translation.

Pricing.title: Simple, flexible pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Create your free account, then choose the plan that fits — you can change or cancel any time.
Pricing.note: Sign up first — you'll choose a plan and enter payment details securely once you're inside your dashboard.

pro.tagline: For solo builders and small projects.

business.tagline: For growing teams that need more room.

About.title: About
About.body: BuilderLab is a ready-made foundation for building a SaaS product, not a company or a product of its own. Accounts, subscriptions, and a working dashboard are already built in, so whoever builds on top of it can spend their time on what makes their product different — not on rebuilding the parts every SaaS needs.
